quota_name: Active VPC peering connections per VPC
description: The maximum number of active VPC peering connections per VPC. This quota can be increased up to a maximum of 125.
The maximum number of characters in a VPC endpoint policy, including white space.

The maximum number of egress-only (outbound-only) internet gateways per Region. This quota is directly tied to the maximum number of VPCs per Region. To increase this quota, increase the number of VPCs per Region.

quota_name: Elastic IP address quota per NAT gateway
description: The maximum number of Elastic IP addresses that can be associated with a single NAT Gateway of connectivity type public.
The maximum number of gateway VPC endpoints per Region. The maximum is 255 gateway endpoints per VPC.

quota_name: Inbound or outbound rules per security group
description: The maximum number of inbound or outbound rules per VPC security group (120 rules in total). This quota is enforced separately for IPv4 and IPv6 rules. A rule that references a security group or prefix list ID counts as one rule each for IPv4 and IPv6. This quota multiplied by the security groups per network interface quota cannot exceed 1000.
The maximum number of interface and gatewayLoadBalancer VPC endpoints per VPC.
The maximum number of internet gateways per Region. This quota is directly tied to the maximum number of VPCs per Region. To increase this quota, increase the number of VPCs per Region.
The maximum number of IPv4 CIDR blocks per VPC. The primary CIDR block and all secondary CIDR blocks count toward this quota. This quota can be increased up to a maximum of 50.
The maximum number of IPv6 CIDR blocks per VPC.
The maximum number of NAT gateways per Availability Zone. This includes NAT gateways in the pending, active, or deleting state.
The maximum number of network ACLs per VPC.
The maximum Network Address Usage for a single VPC.
The maximum number of network interfaces per Availability Zone in a Region.
The maximum number of outstanding VPC peering connection requests that you've requested.
The maximum number of distinct participant accounts that subnets in a VPC can be shared with. This is a per VPC quota and applies across all the subnets shared in a VPC.
The maximum Network Address Usage for a VPC and its peers.

quota_name: Private IP address quota per NAT gateway
description: The maximum number of private IP addresses that can be assigned to a single NAT Gateway of connectivity type private.
The maximum number of regional NAT gateways per VPC. This includes regional NAT gateways in the pending, active, or deleting state.
The maximum number of route tables per VPC. The main route table counts toward this quota.

The maximum number of non-propagated routes per route table. This quota can be increased up to a maximum of 1000; however, network performance might be impacted. This quota is enforced separately for IPv4 and IPv6 routes.

The maximum number of inbound rules or outbound rules per network ACL (a total of 40 rules). This includes both IPv4 and IPv6 rules, and the default deny rules. This quota can be increased up to a maximum of 40; however, network performance might be impacted.
The maximum number of security groups per network interface. The maximum is 16. This quota, multiplied by the quota for rules per security group, cannot exceed 1000.
The maximum number of subnets per VPC.

quota_name: Subnets that can be shared with an account
description: The maximum number of subnets that can be shared with an AWS account.
The maximum number of VPC associations per security group.

quota_name: VPC Block Public Access exclusions per account per Region
description: The maximum number of VPC Block Public Access exclusions that an account can have in a single Region at a time.

quota_name: VPC endpoints of type 'resource' per VPC
description: The maximum number of single resource endpoints in a VPC. For additional capacity and limit increases, contact AWS Support.

quota_name: VPC endpoints of type 'service network' per VPC
description: The maximum number of service network endpoints in a VPC. For additional capacity and limit increases, contact AWS Support.

quota_name: VPC peering connection request expiry hours
description: The maximum number of hours after which an unaccepted VPC peering connection request expires. The default value is 168 hours (one week).
The maximum number of VPC security groups per Region.
The maximum number of VPCs per Region. This quota is directly tied to the maximum number of internet gateways per Region.
